design_rationale.format_policy: Deliberately oversample the 29 indexed tabular and four indexed hierarchical records while retaining archive, geospatial/image, documentation/text, semistructured, and unknown-format strata.
design_rationale.organization_policy: Cap selected contribution at five records per organization because two organizations account for 4,280 of 5,823 catalog records.
design_rationale.split_policy: Freeze 15 development, 10 validation, and 25 sealed test records before package_show expansion or resource outcomes are inspected.
design_rationale.claim_limit: This is a stratified external capability pilot, not a prevalence-weighted estimate of the complete NDP catalog.
